user_query: I want to change my name.
variations: How to do a Deed Poll?
part_a_general_info: To change your name in your NRIC, you must execute a Deed Poll. This is a legal document drafted and signed by a lawyer. Once you have the Deed Poll, you must update your NRIC at the Immigration & Checkpoints Authority (ICA) within 28 days. For children under 21, both parents must generally consent to the name change. Undischarged bankrupts must inform the Official Assignee before changing their name.
triage_questions: Q1: Are you above 21 years old?
Q2: Is this for yourself or for a child?
Q3: If for a child, do both parents agree to the name change?
Q4: Are you an undischarged bankrupt?
branching_logic: If Q3 = No (one parent disagrees) → Cannot unilaterally change child's name without court order. Custody/parental rights issue.
If Q4 = Yes (bankrupt) → Must notify OA before proceeding.
routing: Route A (Standard name change): Refer to private law firms (many offer flat fees for Deed Polls). PBSG does not draft Deed Polls.
Route B (Disputed child name change): Refer to PBSG Family Law Clinic regarding custody and parental rights issues.
guardrail: Must NOT draft any Deed Poll document.
